name: Spirit Whisperer Conversation With Kamiko
source:
She died, but no one ever asked her what really happened. Now she speaks—and you're the only one listening. What you say will decide whether she finally moves on… or disappears forever. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3828350/Spirit_Whisperer_Conversation_With_Kamiko/?curator_clanid=4777282]Steam[/url]]
translation:
她死了，但没有人问她到底发生了什么。现在她说话了——而你是唯一一个在听的人。你所说的话将决定她是否最终继续前进……还是永远消失。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3828350/Spirit_Whisperer_Conversation_With_Kamiko/?curator_clanid=4777282]Steam[/url]]
